Several days (many hours of travelling, puzzles and bosses)

A long quest of binary-code riddles that takes you all over Tibia following the story of the Planegazers. You start by finding an {item:Opticording Sphere} in a secret chamber in Ab'Dendriel, collect five visions, activate several ancient forges, defeat the {creature:Last Planegazer} and forge {item:The Supreme Cube}, inside which you solve 30 puzzle rooms until you face the {creature:Planestrider}. You receive the {item:Mysterious Metal Egg}, the {item:Lightsphere}, {item:The Supreme Cube}, a {item:Monolith of the Planes Kit} and the title *Planegazer*.
Hole south of the fruit shop, north of Ab'Dendriel

After using the {item:Blue Spectacles} on all the forges: at the Gnome Deep Hub forge, the {item:Opticorder Rectifier} (with the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere} in your backpack) opens an {item:Energy Gate} leading there.
With the 3 *Vocal Keys* from the NPCs of the Headquarters of the Planegazers.
Team of up to 5 players; the Last Planegazer can be fought every 7 days and always drops a new {item:The Cube}.
Teleport from the Gnomegate to Gnomebase Alpha

Take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} from **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron** (150 gp): say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} to the captain. On the island, enter the **only hole** (south of {npc:Scrutinon}). On floor -1, follow the underground passage **northeast** and enter the {item:Water Vortex}. On the other side, use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot to climb up and head **north** to {wiki:Gray Beach} (it has a depot and a temple to the northwest).

In Gray Beach, enter the teleport to {wiki:Fiehonja} (it becomes available once you have done the shortcut of the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest}; to walk underwater you need the upgrades from {npc:Spectulus}, from the first part of that quest). You appear next to the {wiki:Qjell} statue. From there head **north**, go down the ramp and keep going north, going up another ramp (in stages 2 and 3 there is no longer a wall blocking the way). Keep going north to the library, with {item:Seashell Bookcase|Seashell Bookcases} on the walls.
Outside the statue's protected area there are Deeplings in large groups.

Go to the main library of {wiki:Fiehonja} (needs stage 2 or 3 of the Deeplings World Change) and use the sphere on the spot where the deepling ornament is on the floor. This vision corresponds to **QJ-((** (another name for {wiki:Qjell}, the god of the Deeplings).

Go back the same way to the Qjell statue and enter the teleport to Gray Beach. To leave the island, do the underground passage in reverse back to Gray Island and talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}).

The {wiki:Horestis Tomb} is in the desert **northwest** of **Ankrahmun**. The entrance is on the floor above the dragon spawn closest to the city. Go in and descend to the first underground floor of the tomb.
Go to the {wiki:Horestis Tomb}, first underground floor, and use the sphere next to the {item:Hieroglyphs} (they are on the walls and pillars). This vision corresponds to **Zoralurk**.
Climb back up the same way to the tomb entrance and walk back to **Ankrahmun**, to the southeast.
Go to the **Ab'Dendriel** temple and use the sphere next to the {item:Strangely Shaped Menhir} (the symbols are on it). This vision corresponds to **Garsharak**.

The symbols are binary code: each group of 8 bits is a letter (ASCII/UTF-8).

**Venore:** the 1st symbol gives *Venore*; the 2nd gives *0c041a07* and the 3rd *000a220d* (hexadecimal). The bytes 0c 04 1a 07 00 0a 22 0d, converted to binary and combined by **XOR** with the letters of *Venore* (repeating V and e at the end), give **Zathroth**.

**Gnomebase:** the binary gives *RZQALTQDE*; swap each letter for the next one in the alphabet (*SARBMUREF*) and reverse it: **FERUMBRAS**.

**Gray Island:** the binary directly gives **QJ-((**.

**Ankrahmun:** the hieroglyphs give **ZORALURK**.

**Ab'Dendriel:** the code is hidden in pixels on the Menhir (described in the book {wiki:Tassondis's Discoveries (Book)}, in the Oramond forge). Take a screenshot with antialiasing turned off, ambient light at 100% and no light sources equipped (using {spell:Great Light} helps). In Paint, pick the colour of the isolated grey pixels with the colour picker, set a strong colour as the second colour and go over them with the eraser using the right mouse button: the dots become visible and spell out **Garsharak**.
Code revealed on the Strangely Shaped Menhir
3. The five witness walls (Mysterious Ornate Chest)

With the five visions, return to the **Ab'Dendriel Forge** (the underground chamber from section 1): use the {item:Shovel} again on the hole north of the city, if it is covered, and go down. Use the skull to the **west** to open the way to the NPC {npc:Mysterious Ornate Chest (NPC)|Mysterious Ornate Chest}.

Say the visions **one at a time**, greeting before each one, **in the order you collected them**. If you followed this guide's order: {key:hi} {key:Zathroth}, {key:hi} {key:Ferumbras}, {key:hi} {key:QJ-((}, {key:hi} {key:Zoralurk}, {key:hi} {key:Garsharak}. Then the chest asks you for the meaning of the five witness walls.

If you use the sphere after getting all five visions, you see: *"The sphere shows a faint glow. You seem to recognise several words: 'Manipulated from above, dancing on a string.'"* The answer (Marionettes) only works after section 4.
Leave the room. If you get stuck, light the torches and use the torch west of the chest to open the passage. Then climb up the hole with the {item:Rope} to the street in Ab'Dendriel.

Travel to the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}, on the surface **west of Kazordoon**. Go down through the south entrance of the mine. The mine entrances are on the surface, west of Kazordoon; if you are in Kazordoon, leave the mountain through the city entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the route from Kazordoon}; bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}). The south entrance is the same one that leads to the {wiki:Sunken Mines}.
Paths between Kazordoon and the Dwarf Mines

Follow the path to the **right** and go down the hole, as if you were going to the {wiki:Sunken Mines}. Walk **south** through the flooded tunnels and keep going **east** until you find a room with a blocked entrance.
To get in you have to step on the squares in a specific order, moving **diagonally**, as shown in the image.
Order of the squares to step on to open the room
If the door closes with you inside, use the torch holder south of the {item:Chalk Board}.
Give the password to the Opticorder Forge

Inside is the NPC {npc:Opticorder Forge (NPC)|Opticorder Forge} and, to the east, a {item:Strangely Shaped Block}. The binary code hidden on the two faces of the block (same method as the Menhir) means **isolated cradle**. Say {key:hi} and then {key:isolated cradle} (the transcript shows *isolated cradles*).
Code revealed on the Strangely Shaped Block

**Use** the **Opticorder Forge** object. From now on, using the sphere shows: *"You seem to recognise several words: 'Key mechanism adjusted' and 'Opticorder key mechanism adjusted. Password required.'"*
The Opticorder Forge in the Dwarf Mines

If the door has closed, use the torch holder south of the {item:Chalk Board}. Then go back the same way: through the flooded tunnels to the **west** and **north**, climb up the hole with the {item:Rope} and leave through the south entrance of the Dwarf Mines.

Return to the **Ab'Dendriel Forge** (through the hole north of Ab'Dendriel, as in section 1) and say {key:hi} and {key:marionettes} to the {npc:Mysterious Ornate Chest (NPC)|Mysterious Ornate Chest} (it comes from the phrase *"Manipulated from above, dancing on a string."*). The chest is unlocked.
If it does not work, use the chest first (to sync) and only then talk to the NPC.
Open the chest and the egg

**Use** the chest to receive the {item:Mysterious Metal Egg}. The egg can be {item:Open Metal Egg|opened} and contains an {item:Opticompass Sphere} and a {item:Rolled-up Parchment}. When you use the Opticompass Sphere you see *"The needle spins inside the compass."*
Mysterious Metal Egg (with Opticompass Sphere and Rolled-up Parchment)
Leave as before: use the south torch holder (II) if the wall is closed and climb up the hole with the {item:Rope}.

The entrance {item:Glowing Vortex} is **southwest** of the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, on the plain between Thais and Kazordoon. Enter the {wiki:Otherworld (Dwarf Bridge)} through the entrance shown. Down there you are in a cave beneath the plain southeast of Thais.
The entrance to this Otherworld is not always there: sometimes it disappears and comes back after a few minutes or hours.
Strong creatures ({creature:Burster|Bursters}, {creature:Instable Breach Brood|Instable Breach Broods}, {creature:Instable Sparkion|Instable Sparkions}): level 90+ recommended (knights 100+).
Kill 10 creatures and enter the vortex
Kill **10 creatures** inside the cave and enter the {item:Glowing Vortex}. If the vortex is not there, wait a few minutes (it is not 2 hours like the HoD vortexes).
Walk **south** until you find a {item:Strange Stone} (*"this stone seems strangely fragile"*). **Throw** any item onto it: a hole opens to the floor below.
Go down the hole. You see a {item:Wrecked Opticorder Forge}: click it to get a {item:Broken Opticording Sphere}.

**Immediately**, use the Broken Opticording Sphere on your {item:Opticording Sphere} to get the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere}. You see: *"The Key mechanism from the broken device is still in perfect condition and completes your opticording sphere."*
The Broken Opticording Sphere disappears **one minute** after you pick it up.

The wiki does not describe a quick exit from the destroyed forge room. Climb up the hole you came down (use the {item:Rope}) and retrace your path **north** to the spot of the {item:Glowing Vortex} you arrived through, and from there to the entrance, southwest of the Dwarf Bridge.
Open the cave east of Krailos

Travel to **Krailos**: there are boats from **Edron**, **Darashia**, **Oramond** (Rathleton) and **Venore** (say {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes} to the captain). The sphere leads you **east** of the city, to a spot with dragon bones. Use a {item:Pick} on the square **north** of the {item:Pile of Bones (Animal)|Pile of Bones} to enter a small cave.
Square to pick, north of the pile of bones

In the northwest of the cave there is a colour puzzle and a corridor behind a stone door. **Remove all light-emitting items** from your character: that way you see the squares change colour (**blue – red – yellow**) when you step on them. On the minimap you see black dots and lines in a corridor, which are binary code.

The {item:Rolled-up Parchment} from the egg says 0000011111011100 = **2012**; the minimap says 00001011 and 00001111 = **11** and **15**. The date is **15/11/12**.
The binary code visible on the cave minimap

Look in Tibia's official news archive for the *teaser* from **15/11/2012** about the Venore renewal. Open the first animated image (gif): it has a very fast frame that, when frozen, shows a **5×5** pattern of blue, red and yellow flowers. That pattern is the solution: paint the squares with those colours. Start from the **south** and work your way **north**. When you finish you are teleported into the room (*"Before you get a chance to react, you find yourself at the other side of a solid wall in the midst of a dark tunnel."*).
The frame taken from the official news post, with the solution
The squares have a timer and go back to normal if you take too long: hurry up.
To get back in later you do not need to repeat the puzzle: use the {item:Stone Wall (Draft)} next to the corridor.

Inside is an {item:Opticorder Analyser}. Click it with the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere} in your backpack. You see *"The device fits. A lock clicks, the strange thing starts rumbling and then grinds to a halt faster than you can say 'magic'."* and the analyser becomes an {item:Opticorder Analyser (Activated)}.

Use the {item:Stone Wall (Draft)} to leave the forge (it is also how you get back in later, without redoing the puzzle). Then go back through the cave to the hole you opened with the {item:Pick}, climb up to the surface and walk **west** to Krailos Village, where you catch the boat.

This part only gives the {item:Lightsphere}. If you only want {item:The Supreme Cube}, you can skip to section 9. You need **2 players**, a melee weapon, Magic Wall runes and (probably) your Opticording Sphere.

Go to the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, north of **Thais** (leave through the city's north exit and keep going north). Enter the **Energy Portal** (you must have unlocked it with {npc:Albinius}, by handing in 50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}, as in the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}). You appear in the {wiki:Replica Dungeon}.

Go to the **Halls of Hope** (access to the gates is explained in the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}). Enter the {item:Energy Portal} and go to the centre of the room. Say the password **PLNSTRDR** in the Local chat or the NPCs channel: you are teleported to another room, one floor down.
The pins of the activated Opticorder Analyser form the password PLNSTRDR in binary
Guide your partner across the platforms

One player enters through the **west** door (the water one) and steps on the {item:Embedded Emerald} floor. The other enters through the **east** door (control room) and steps on the {item:Embedded Topaz}. The control-room player's movements (including diagonals) are copied by the player on the platforms. You can step on a {item:Platform Rising From Water} or a {item:Platform Sinking Into Water}, but if you step on a {item:Platform Under Water} you fall into the water and are sent out of the room. Take your partner to the **lever** and pull it: both of you are teleported to the {creature:An Observer Eye} room.
The player on the west side (Embedded Emerald) hardly has to do anything; the other one does the hard work
The player on the east side (Embedded Topaz) has to guide their partner to the lever without letting them fall into the water
The platforms rise and sink at random: whoever gives the commands has to stay alert. You have 5 minutes before being teleported out, but you can try as many times as you like.
Cut the cable that powers the eye

**Do not attack the eye yet.** Advance slowly through the room, protecting yourself with {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls}. At the end of the room, break the wall with the melee weapon. Inside, use the Opticording Analyzer: a sphere appears on top of it and the cable is cut.
Now kill the {creature:An Observer Eye}. Stay in the row of squares against the **north wall** and **do not walk south**. It drops the {item:Lightsphere}.

**Never get close to the eye**: its beam takes off up to 99% of your total health. Do not use {wiki:Special Summons} (they can get close and trigger the beam). A team of two knights probably will not kill it in time.
When you leave you are sent to a room with **5 or more servants** (replicas). Get ready before you leave.
After getting past the servants' room, go back the same way to where you arrived in the Replica Dungeon and enter the **Energy Portal** there: it takes you back to the Halls of Hope, north of Thais.
Get to the Gnome Deep Hub

The entrance to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub} is in **Kazordoon**, near the **north** blesser (4 floors below ground level). To get to Kazordoon, take the {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from **Farmine** ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}, or walk in through the mountain entrance. Alternatively, use the GCTS (the Kazordoon crystal is next to the hub entrance).
Get to the Gnome Deep Hub forge

There is a forge below the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}. Enter {npc:Gnomus}'s task area: go to the **easternmost** part of the hub, go down at the marked spot and climb the next ramp; follow the cave **east** to the **Lost Ruin**. Use the {item:Skull Pillar (Stone)|Skull Pillar} once and the {item:Pillar Vine} once: you are sent to the forge.
In the corridors marked with a skull sign, a shower of rocks (**1500 physical damage**) can fall when a {creature:Lost Gnome} walks nearby.

In the forge there is an {item:Opticorder Rectifier} and, in the chest right next to it, the {item:Blue Spectacles}. Pick them up. (You can read about a planegazer's experiments in {wiki:Lone Gatekeeper (Book)}.)
See the ghosts in the five forges

Use the {item:Blue Spectacles} in each of the forges (*sites*) to see its ghost. How to reach each one: **Gnome Deep Hub** — the forge you are in (use the spectacles near the plantations); **Ab'Dendriel** — through the hole north of the city (section 1); **Sunken Mines** — the Opticorder Forge from section 4; **Rathleton** — go down at the first spot on the map, then at the second (sewers) and finally through the sewer grate; the room is below; **Krailos** — enter through the {item:Stone Wall (Draft)} (section 7). Leave each one the same way you came in.
In the forge where you picked them up, near the plantations
Room at {coord:33676,31916,11}: go down at {coord:33621,31981,7}, then at {coord:33660,31892,9} and finally through the sewer grate at {coord:33671,31916,10}
Open the portal with the Opticorder Rectifier

After using the spectacles in all the forges, go back to the **Gnome Deep Hub** one. Use the {item:Opticorder Rectifier} with the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere} in your backpack. You see *"The very moment you place the opticorder into the rectifier a beam of light emerges to create a gate directly across the room."* Enter the {item:Energy Gate} to reach the {wiki:Headquarters of the Planegazers}.

There are many {creature:Ghost of a Planegazer|Ghosts of Planegazers}: they are very hard to kill alone and are not much of a threat, so ignore them. They attack from range; keep them away with {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs} and {item:Fire Wall Rune|Fire Walls}. You have to collect 3 *Vocal Keys* by talking to the three NPCs to the **southeast** (marked on the map). Greet them all with the password {key:PLNSTRDR}.

Say {key:PLNSTRDR} to {npc:Yielothax (NPC)|Yielothax}. He tells you they asked *EIGHT* and the answer was *FIVE*, they asked *SIXTEEN* and the answer was *SEVEN*, and he asks you *SEVEN*. The answer is the number of letters in the word: answer {key:five}.

Say {key:PLNSTRDR} to {npc:Glimpse of Allusion}. He asks questions about a traveller from Edron (the answers are in the book {wiki:The Travelling Savant (Book)}, in a room in the north part of the map). Answer {key:yes}, {key:Fiehonja}, {key:Tin Key} and {key:Food Crate}.

Say {key:PLNSTRDR} to {npc:WOX}. He speaks {wiki:Jekhr} (the Deeplings' language) and asks *"The surface come in peace. And we let him stay. What are you?"*. Answer that you are a visitor: {key:buhel}. (This dialogue is also in a {wiki:Deepling Book 1 (Book)|book} in the Fiehonja library.)

With the 3 Vocal Keys you can enter the {wiki:Chamber of Reflections} with a team of **up to 5 players**. Kill the bosses one at a time: {creature:Reflection of a Mage}, {creature:Reflection of Mawhawk}, {creature:Reflection of Obujos} and {creature:Last Planegazer}. The reflections are similar to the originals. The Last Planegazer has similar strength to Reflection of Obujos and can be attacked with all elements **except death**. The blocker can trap it in one of the small corridors to the north so that it does not switch targets to the ranged attackers.
There is a **10-minute** limit before you are kicked out of the boss room.
The Cube (Last Planegazer loot; you can repeat the fight every 7 days and you always get a new one)

When the 10 minutes are up you are kicked out of the boss room. The wiki does not describe another exit from the {wiki:Headquarters of the Planegazers}: go back the same way to the Gnome Deep Hub forge, return to the hub through Gnomus's area and leave through the **Kazordoon** entrance (or through the GCTS crystal next to it).
{item:The Cube} is incomplete. You find {item:The Missing Piece of the Cube} by going down a small crypt **north of Edron**. To leave the crypt, climb back up the same way to the surface.
Where The Missing Piece of the Cube is
The Missing Piece of the Cube has a 24-hour cooldown.
Go to the final forge on Gray Island

With the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere}, {item:The Cube} and {item:The Missing Piece of the Cube}, travel to **Gray Island** and from there to **Gray Beach** (as in the "Get to Gray Beach" step of section 2). From Gray Beach follow the coast **east** and go down the easternmost hole. Down there is a small platform by the water: step on it to enter the last Opticording Forge.
Use the three items on the {item:Opticording Combinator}, **north** of you, and then use the machine to combine them into {item:The Supreme Cube}.
You can forge The Supreme Cube without killing An Observer Eye or the Last Planegazer if you get the items from another character. You can also forge several Cubes.

The wiki does not describe a separate exit from this forge: go back the same way to Gray Beach. To leave the island, do the underground passage in reverse back to Gray Island and talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}).

Bring one or two extra regular {item:Pick|Picks}: they save you a lot of time if you get a puzzle wrong. To leave the Cube, use the symbols on the walls northeast of any puzzle room twice, or use the Cube again. There is a **2-hour** cooldown between each use of the Supreme Cube.
Use {item:The Supreme Cube} anywhere, as long as you do not have a *battle sign*.
